registration: sealed design and admission rules; execution and confirmation blocked
task: validate precommitted cheap-background recommendations against fixed interventions on a complete measured menu
population: the twelve named, recommendation-stratified pilot lines only; no representative-population claim

design.physical_unit: verified separately initiated culture; sister aliquots share parent
design.dependencies: technical wells share culture and controls; plates/day share environment; do not count wells as independent
design.split: no pilot fitting or confirmation claim; future whole culture/day/parent-connected components remain in one split
design.timing: 24 h seeding wait, then 72 h treatment; proposal, not certified historical timing

inputs.background: cell identity and precommitted roster recommendation only; usable-before-decision receipt required
inputs.state: not used in primary pilot; destructive sister ATP is not same-cell state or a registered state-gain input

policies.selection_strategy: precommitted_lookup; no orchestrator default or online policy search
policies.parameters: C_action integer indexes the frozen ordered menu; never refit on pilot
policies.predictions: precommitted diagnostic/recommendation asset; no STATE or mechanism-conditional model claim
policies.model_version: original frozen recommendation; training checkpoint contract remains unknown
policies.stop: no new interventions, readouts, policy fitting, thresholds or repeats selected from pilot outcomes

analysis.normalized_readout: (ATP_action - mean matched terminal blanks) / (mean matched terminal vehicle - mean matched terminal blanks)
analysis.response_utility: 1 - normalized_readout; no clipping, no death/GR/clinical interpretation
analysis.technical_aggregation: prespecified QC-passing technical wells averaged within culture/action; retain every failed attempt
analysis.primary_estimand: equal cell-line mean of within-culture recommendation utility minus fixed Afatinib utility
analysis.uncertainty: pilot descriptive differences only; no physical confidence interval without certified culture/batch independence
analysis.action_contrast: report complete-menu within-culture pair differences and reproducibility across the two starts; no state interaction claim
analysis.missing_actions: unidentified unless trusted outcome/cost bounds were registered before outcomes; never substitute model output
analysis.qc: matched culture/control/plate required, finite raw values and positive vehicle-minus-blank range; numeric assay thresholds require independent validation before execution
analysis.costs: record failed/unexecuted attempts, measurement, preparation, time and compute; unknown prices remain unknown
analysis.abstention: no new policy refusal threshold; invalid/unsupported records are unassessable with their costs retained

before_execution: verify actual culture/parent/sister identities and independent starts
operator-approved medium, controls, handling and numeric assay QC
background availability -> decision -> allocation -> actual execution chronology
full attempt, failure and outcome ledger with raw files and hashes
pre-outcome approved prices, failure/refusal utility and minimum meaningful gain

later_state_comparison.design: within-background full menu; background vs background plus cheap measured confluence/cell count, condition-local state permutation, same-input simple predictor
later_state_comparison.availability: state processing complete and readable before decision; record collection/wait/drift/cost and legal sister linkage
later_state_comparison.stop: if state only predicts common response magnitude or action contrasts do not generalize, stop the action-gain claim

mechanism_comparison.status: blocked; ATP pilot cannot resolve mechanism

historical_exposure: prior GDSC retrospective outcomes were already reviewed; only new unexecuted pilot outcomes could be held out
